messages:
maria: FYI — noticed incidentbot suppressed pages to #oncall-prod for ~20m starting ~1784123460. Multiple PD alerts were created but no pages sent. Customers reported delayed response. Anyone on this? :eyes:
sam: saw the spike in suppressed_count in metrics. I think this is the new auth/header handling patch from the mid-day deploy. digging now.
raj: I can take oncall for mitigation if needed. any quick workaround to ensure pages go out?
sam: quick root cause — header parsing bug. code uses: `suppress = bool(headers.get('x-inc-suppress'))` so values like '0' or '1' are truthy in Python strings. when header absent we explicitly set '0' upstream, so bool('0') == True -> suppressing pages. ugh.
incidentbot: [system] detected suppression flag present; skipping page fanout (inc id=INC-5231)
maria: oof. thanks for spotting. can we override suppression in the bot until patched?
sam: yes — pushing hotfix to treat '1'/'true' as True, everything else False. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/incidentbot/pulls/412
deploy-bot: [prod rollout] release/incidentbot-hotfix @ 1784123602 starting canary
ops: We manually escalated two pages via PD UI at 1784123520 and 1784123550 to make sure critical customers got paged. Tracking impacted customers now.
raj: after canary looks good, will flip suppress-default to False in the env to cover any edge cases. also adding a runtime assert for header parsing.
sam: hotfix is live in prod at 1784123700. metrics show suppressed_count back to baseline and new pages being delivered. testing sending a synthetic alert now.
incidentbot: [system] page sent to oncall-prod (inc id=INC-5232)
maria: thanks. can we confirm customer impact numbers? product/success?
ops: preliminary: 3 customer incidents saw >5m delay, 1 enterprise customer opened a case. I've started a customer outreach draft.
raj: filing a postmortem ticket, will include timeline, root cause (bool('0') bug), mitigation (hotfix + env flip), and remediation (unit tests, header schema validation at gateway, integration test for suppression semantics).
sam: also adding a deploy-gate: block deploys touching header parsing unless unit/integration tests present.
maria: good. I'll notify legal/compliance for the enterprise case and loop in account team. adding to daily retro. :+1:
ops: creating incident page and tagging for sev2 postmortem.
maria: closing out thread here — thanks everyone for quick response.
